dedupe_keys.name: a spatially aligned rgb event modality dataset for roadside traffic object detection

description: A Spatially Aligned RGB-Event Modality Dataset for Roadside Traffic Object Detection is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Mingyong Zhuang et al. Event cameras are promising for traffic perception. However, due to the limited availability of high-quality datasets, especially those with well-aligned and uniformly annotated dual-modal ones, roadside traffic applications remain underexplored. We propose the Dual-modal Roadside Traffic Dataset (DRTD) to support traffic object detection research from a fixed roadside perspective. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The paper's page was read, but no repository address could be taken from its machine-readable metadata, so the record links to the article, whose Data Records section names where the data sit. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
